Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 1) Two students appeared at an examination. One of them secured 9 marks more than the other and his marks was 56% of the sum of their marks. The marks obtained by them are:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
One got = 56
Another got = 100 - 56 = 44
The difference = 56 - 44 = 12
12% is equal to 9
So 44% is equal to (9/12) × 44 = 33
And 56% is equal to (9/12) × 56 = 42

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 2) In an election between two candidates, one got 55% of the total valid votes, 20% of the votes were invalid. If the total number of votes was 7500, the number of valid votes that the other candidate got, was:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Valid = 100 - 20 = 80
Loser candidates got = 45% of 80 (since winner got 55% of valid vote)
= 36% of valid votes
So, loser got = 36% of 7500 of total votes
= 2700

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
r = 50
So consumption should reduced = (r/100+r) × 100
= (50/150) × 100
= 33.33% that means 1/3

7) If A's income is 80% of B's income, then B's income is more than A's income by -
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
When A’s income is Tk 80 B’s Income is Tk 100
when A’s income is Tk 1 B’s Income is Tk 100/80
when A’s income is Tk 100 B’s Income is Tk (100/80) × 100 = 125%

So, A’s income is 125 - 100 = 25% more

Short-cut,
A’s income is 20% less than B’s
r = 20%
(r/100 - r) × 100
(20/100) × 100
= 25%

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 8) A person's salary has increased from tk7200 to tk.8100. What is the percentage increase in his salary?
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Salary Increased = 8100-7200 = 900
Percent increased = (900/7200) × 100 = 12.5%

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 10) A man spends 35% of his income on food, 25% on children's education and 80% of the remaining on house rent. What percent of his income he is left with?
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Let, total income = 100
Total expense food and education = 35 + 25
= 60
Remaining = (100 - 60) = 40
Expense on house rent = 40 × (80/100) = 32
Remaining after all expense = 40 - 32 = 8

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 11) A salesman gets commission on total sales at 9%. If the sale is exceeded Tk.10,000 he gets an additional commission as bonus of 3% on the excess of sales over Tk.10,000. If he gets total commission of Rs.1380, then what is the sales:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
For 10000, he got = 10000 × 9% = 900
Extra Commission he got = 1380 - 900 = 480
Commission in percent = 9% + 3% = 12%
He got Tk 12 commission for Tk 100
He got Tk 1 commission for Tk 100/12
He got Tk 480 commission for Tk (100/12) × 480
= 4000

প্রশ্নে additional sales জানতে চাওয়ার কথা ছিলো।
সেক্ষেত্রে সঠিক উত্তর - খ) 4000 হয়।
কিন্তু অপশনে Total sales - এর পরিমাণ না থাকায় উত্তর বাতিল করা হয়েছে।

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 16) If the selling price is doubled, the profit triples. Find the profit percent.
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Let C.P. be Tk. x and S.P. be Tk. y.
Then, 3(y - x) = (2y - x) y = 2x.
Profit = tk. (y - x) = Rs. (2x - x) = Rs. x.
Profit % = (x/x 100) % = 100%

18) Some articles were bought at 6 articles for TK. 5 and sold at 5 articles for Tk. 6. Gain percent is:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Suppose, number of articles bought = L.C.M. of 6 and 5 = 30.
C.P. of 30 articles = TK.(5/6)x 30 = Tk. 25.
S.P. of 30 articles = Tk. (6/5)x 30 = Tk. 36.
Gain % = (11/25)x 100 = 44%.

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 19) The price of an article was increased by p% . Later the new price was decreased by p%. If the latest price was TK. 1, The original price was:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
At p% profit, selling price = 100 + p
at p% loss, new selling price = (100 + p) - (100 + p) × p/100
= (100 + p) - {(100p + p2)/100}
= 10000 + 100p - 100p - p2
= (10000 - p2)/100

so, (10000 - p2)/100 is equal to 1
1 is equal to 1/(10000 - p2)/100
100 is equal to 1 × (100/ 10000 - p2) × 100
= 10000/(10000 - p2)

অপশন গ) (10000/10000-p^2) হওয়ার কথা ছিলো। সেক্ষেত্রে উত্তর ঠিক হয়।
লাইভ পরীক্ষার প্রশ্নে অপশন ভুল থাকায় উত্তর হিসাবে ঙ) None of above কে ধরা হয়েছে।

so selling price of 36 oranges is Tk. 36
loses on oranges is Tk. 4
so cost price = 36+4=40
therefore, Loss percent= (loss/cost price) × 100

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 22) A man sells two horses for tk 4000 each, neither losing nor gaining in the deal. If he sold 1 horse at a gain of 25%, the other horse is sold at a loss of:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
ধরি প্রথম ঘোড়ার ক্রয়মূল্য = x টাকা
তাহলে, x + x এর 25/100 = 4000
বা, x = 3200 টাকা

তাহলে প্রথম ঘোড়ার ক্ষেত্রে মোট লাভ করেছে ৮০০ টাকা তাহলে দ্বিতীয় ঘোড়াতে ক্ষতি হয়েছে = ৮০০ টাকা

তাহলে দ্বিতীয় ঘোড়ার ক্রয়মূল্য = ৪০০০ + ৮০০ = ৪৮০০ টাকা।

তাহলে ক্ষতির শতকরা হার = (৮০০ × ১০০) / ৪৮০০  = ১৬.৬৭%

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 23) A radio sold a loss of 2.5%. Had he sold it for Tk. 100 more, he would have gained 7.5%. In order to gain 12.5%, he should sell it for:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Cost Price = 100
Selling price = 100 - 2.5 = 97.5
New selling price at 7.5% = 107.5
difference between two selling price = 107.5 - 97.5 = 10
10% price is equal to Tk. 100
1% price is equal to Tk. 100/10%
100% price is equal to Tk. (100/10%) × 100
= 1000
so Cost price = 1000
SP at 12.5% = (100+12.5/100) × 1000
= 1125

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 24) A dealer sells a radio at a gain of 10%. If he had bought it at 10% less and sold it for Tk. 132 less, he would have still gained 10%. The cost price of the radio is:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Cost Price = 100
Selling price = 100 + 10 = 110
New cost price after 10% less = 100 - 10 = 90
New selling price = 90 × (110/100) = 99
difference between two selling price = 110 - 99 = 11%
11% price is equal to Tk. 132
1% price is equal to Tk. 132/11%
100% price is equal to Tk. (132/11%) × 100
= 1200

Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.question: 25) A tradesman by means of a false balance defrauds to the extent of 8% in buying goods and also defrauds to 8% in selling. His gain percent is:
Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount.exp:
Since he make 8% profit so his purchase = 100 + 8 = 108
He make 8% more profit during sales so his sales = (108/100) × 108 = 116.64
so profit = 116.64 - 100
= 16.64
Short Cut (with increase decrease short cut)
X + Y + (xy/100)
= 8 + 8 + (8×8/100) ( since he his making profit so count is as a increase)
= 16.64
